Ella (Sales): Hey team — Aurora (large fintech) wants a 40% off list for a 12‑month committed Dedicated plan. They want dedicated GPUs + private deploy. Need approval to offer before EOD so we don't lose traction. cc @Devon for PO C logistics.
Sam (Deal Desk): 40% is pretty wide. What's the ARR if they commit 12 months? Need committed $ numbers to run discount model.
Ella (Sales): Ballpark committed spend = $420k ARR (monthly invoiced). They want start-of-Q2 onboarding and can sign a 12mo MSA.
Matt (RevenueOps): Tagging margin calc. With 40% off list our unit margin goes below the standard threshold for Dedicated. Can we see target unit economics and whether they need SLA add-ons?
Devon (CSM): They're doing a pilot now with ~500k tokens/day; projected prod load 2–3M tokens/day. They'll want SLOs and an onboarding week with our infra team. If we give heavy discount we should trade for a committed ramp schedule + feature prioritization.
Claire (Finance): Standard guardrail: up to 25% discount for revenue>250k ARR with Regional Sales VP signoff. >25% requires RevOps + CFO approval for bespoke. 40% will need Exec signoff.
deals-bot: New discount request created: DR-2026-045 by Ella. Link: https://redwood.internal/deals/DR-2026-045
Sam (Deal Desk): Proposed alternatives: (A) 30% off + $50k onboarding credit, or (B) 25% off + 3 months free pilot credits + accelerated ROI plan. Which does sales prefer?
Ella (Sales): Prefer option A (30% + $50k onboarding) — keeps margin closer to acceptable and helps get them live quickly. Can RevOps sign off on 30%?
Matt (RevenueOps): 30% looks possible if we structure as: 20% up-front list discount + 10% as promo credit spread across the first 6 invoices. That reduces initial cash impact. Need Claire to confirm accounting treatment for the credit.
Claire (Finance): Accounting OK for split treatment but still needs exec visibility. If you structure as Matt suggested and tie additional 5% to a 12–24 week volume ramp milestone, Finance is more comfortable.
Devon (CSM): I'll draft an onboarding & ramp SLA that ties the extra 5% to hitting 1.5M tokens/day by week 12. Will share draft today.
Sam (Deal Desk): Okay. For formal approval path: RevOps approves commercial structure -> Finance acknowledges -> Sales VP + CRO signoff if final effective discount >30%. Please attach draft contract language and ramp SLA.
Ella (Sales): Thanks. I'll update the customer with a conditional offer: 30% off list + $50k onboarding credit; extra 5% applied when ramp milestone met. Sending draft MSA and ramp SLA to this thread shortly.
Matt (RevenueOps): Once you post the draft, I’ll run sensitivity on net revenue and unit economics. If numbers hold, I'll greenlight and loop in CRO.
Claire (Finance): FYI — if we end up with 35–40% effective discount we need to reserve for potential churn; please include a termination clause limiting refund obligations.
Ella (Sales): Copy — uploading docs now.
Ella (Sales): ```
Summary offer for Aurora:
- Commitment: 12 months Dedicated, starts 2026-04-01
- Committed spend: $420,000 ARR
- Commercial: 30% off list (applied month 1–12) + $50,000 onboarding credit
- Additional 5% discount unlocked if 1.5M tokens/day sustained for 2 consecutive weeks within first 12 weeks
- Onboarding SLA: 5 business days of dedicated infra support + weekly checkpoints
```
Sam (Deal Desk): Received. Matt + Claire please review. If approved I'll route to VP/CRO signature.
Matt (RevenueOps): Reviewing now — small ask: make the onboarding credit non-refundable and apply to professional services line.
Claire (Finance): Approved with the non-refundable PS credit treatment and milestone. Finance acknowledges, pending CRO signature.
Devon (CSM): Draft SLA attached — includes observability handoff, runbook, and success metrics.
Sam (Deal Desk): All green from deal desk — routing to CRO for final signoff (expect reply within 24h). :rocket:
Ella (Sales): Thanks all — will stand by and prep legal redlines. :thumbsup:
